fixedAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:365 subdivision of vaste activa into intangible, tangible and financial fixed assets; the three sum to the balanceSheet.fixedAssets total.

intangibleAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:365(1) separate disclosure of intangible fixed assets: development costs, concessions/licences/IP, goodwill paid and prepayments on intangibles.

tangibleAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:366 subdivision of tangible fixed assets: land and buildings, plant and machinery, other operating assets, assets under construction / prepayments.

financialFixedAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:367 disclosure of financial fixed assets: participating interests, group/participation receivables, other securities, other receivables.

groupReceivables.description: Receivables from group companies and participations.

currentAssetClasses.description: NL BW 2:369 subdivision of vlottende activa into inventories, receivables, securities and cash; the four sum to the balanceSheet.currentAssets total.

equityComponents.description: NL BW 2:373 split of eigen vermogen into issued capital, share premium (agio), revaluation reserve, statutory/articles reserves and retained result; the five sum to the balanceSheet.equity total.

liabilitiesMaturity.description: NL BW 2:375 maturity split of schulden: the short-term and long-term (over one year) portions sum to the balanceSheet.liabilities total, and the over-five-years portion is a subset of the long-term portion.

shortTerm.description: Portion with a remaining term up to one year.

longTerm.description: Portion with a remaining term over one year.

overFiveYears.description: Portion (of the long-term) with a remaining term over five years.

capitalisedDevelopmentCosts.description: RJ 210 — the unamortised carrying amount of capitalised development costs. When positive a legal reserve of at least this amount must be maintained within equity.

developmentLegalReserve.description: RJ 210 — the non-distributable legal reserve (wettelijke reserve) held within equity for capitalised development costs.

intangibleAmortisationYears.description: RJ 210 — the estimated useful life over which an intangible fixed asset is amortised; shall not exceed twenty years.

sbrFiled.description: True when the statutory KvK deposit was performed via an SBR (XBRL) instance on the RGS/NT taxonomy (required for micro/small entities).

balanceDetailLevel.description: DE HGB 266 balance-sheet detail level. 'abridged' (only lettered/Roman-numeral items) is permitted for micro/small corporations; 'full' otherwise.

equityComponentsHgb.description: DE HGB 268 breakdown of Eigenkapital: subscribed capital, capital reserve, revenue reserves, retained earnings carried forward and net income/loss for the year.

pnlNatureBreakdown.description: DE HGB 275 total-cost method (Gesamtkostenverfahren) expense breakdown by nature, with the change in inventory and own work capitalised shown separately. Required when the categorical P&L model is applied.

pnlFunctionBreakdown.description: DE HGB 275 cost-of-sales method (Umsatzkostenverfahren) expense breakdown by function. Required when the functional P&L model is applied.

retentionYearsAccounts.description: Retention period in years for books, inventories, opening balance sheets and annual accounts (DE HGB 257 and FR PCG require at least 10 years).

retentionYearsCorrespondence.description: Retention period in years for commercial correspondence (DE HGB 257 requires at least 6 years).

balancePresentation.description: FR PCG balance-sheet (bilan) presentation. The base system presents the balance sheet in table form.

pnlResultBreakdown.description: FR PCG income-statement (compte de résultat) result breakdown distinguishing operating, financial and exceptional result.

pnlPresentation.description: FR PCG income-statement presentation. The compte de résultat is presented in list form.

accountingSystem.description: FR PCG accounting system. 'abrege' (système abrégé) is permitted within the small/micro thresholds; 'base' (système de base) is required above them; 'developpe' is the developed system.

confidentialFiling.description: FR — true when the small/micro company has requested that its filed accounts remain confidential and not be made public.

fecExportAvailable.description: FR — true when the entity (keeping computerised accounts) can produce the FEC (Fichier des Écritures Comptables) on a tax audit.

fecStructuredEntries.description: FR FEC entries presented with the full prescribed per-entry structural fields (JournalCode, EcritureNum, EcritureDate, CompteNum, PieceRef, Debit, Credit) — the field-complete view used to evaluate fec-field-structure, distinct from the balance-only fecEntries.

journalCode.description: JournalCode — the journal the entry belongs to.

ecritureDate.description: EcritureDate — the accounting date of the entry.

notesBlockTagged.description: EU ESEF — true when the notes to the IFRS consolidated statements are block-tagged at section level. Required for listed issuers.

taxonomyExtensionsUsed.description: EU ESEF — true when the issuer uses extension (custom) taxonomy elements for disclosures with no matching core element.

extensionsAnchored.description: EU ESEF — true when every extension element is anchored to the closest standard taxonomy element(s). Required whenever extensions are used.
